title: ficus scaberrima var. angustata
intro: Ficus scaberrima var. angustata, commonly known as the Indian fig tree or wild banyan, is a plant species within the Moraceae family. It has been utilized in traditional medicine to promote overall well-being, particularly in the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Ficus scaberrima var. angustata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
